newsitem.title: NORWAY: POLL-Bergesen expected to post strong H1.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Bergesen expected to post strong H1.

text.p: Norway's largest shipping company Bergesen ASA is expected to more than double profits before tax in the first half of the year compared with the same 1996 period.
A Reuters' poll of nine analysts forecast a pre-tax result of 440 million crowns compared with 153 million crowns a year ago.
The figures are exclusive of gains from foreign exchange but include a sales profit of 72 million crowns booked in the second quarter.

Seven of the analysts recommended a "buy" on the stock and two said "hold". The latter two said they were cautious because the share make a large advances in a short time, but both said they had the company under review for a possible upwards adjustment.
Most analysts saw an improved market for the gas sector especially for large vessels, while there was still some uncertainty tied to smaller vessels.
However, they said it was the tanker sector which gave the extremely positive sentiment towards the company.

"I am most excited by the gas sector, but when earnings are around $40,000 per day for a VLCC against estimates of $23,000, it says for itself that tankers give a large positive effect," said one of the analysts with a buy hold recommendation.
Bergesen is due to release first-half results on Thursday. Following lists analysts' estimates.
